pages.text: If you need to get some Lava for whatever reason, here is a method invented by a Dustologist: $(br) 1. Make an $(item)Energized Cobblestone$(). $(br) 2. Use a $(item)Smithing Table$() to make an $(item)Energized Cobblestone Bucket$(). $(br) 3. Put it in a $(item)Furnace$() and smelt it.
